fields.description: Issue dated June 30, 1928, published in Miami, Florida. Coverage includes editorials and local commentary on Al Capone’s presence in Miami and criticism of press and civic campaigns against him; discussion of Dade County Republican organizing for the 1928 elections; promotion and logistics for the Elks National Convention (including grandstand seat sales and decorators); excerpts and debate regarding Fort Lauderdale/Broward County objections to Miami’s commercial and highway advocacy; and additional local notes, letters to the editor, and advertisements.
